events.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
events.description:
Building: Student Center Room: Movie Theater Organizer: Badlands Film Appreciation Society Category: Clubs and Orgs,Community Events,Fine and Performing Arts,Student Activities Audience: Pu blic Cost to attend: Free Link: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0093748/?ref\_=nv\_sr\_srsg\_0\_tt\_8\_nm\_0\_in\_0\_q\_planes%20trains

Perhaps the perfect movie to represent the very American holiday Thanksgiving, Planes, Trains and Automobiles \(1987, R\) captures e verything about the holiday. The weary traveling to get home. Being grateful for what you have in life. And being kind to those around you. Director John Hughes made a career on bringing Chicago to life, and in this story it's the struggle to get to the Windy City that takes center stage. Join comedians Steve Martin and John Candy as they are thrown together and trying to survive the journey and each other. Part of the Badlands Film Appreciation Society's Everlasting Eighties series \(bfas .art\).

events.title: Babette's Feast
events.description:
Building: Student Center Room: Movie Theater Organizer: Badlands Film Appreciation Society Category: Clubs and Orgs,Community Events,Fine and Performing Arts,Student Activities Audience: Pu blic Cost to attend: Free Link: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0093748/?ref\_=nv\_sr\_srsg\_0\_tt\_8\_nm\_0\_in\_0\_q\_planes%20trains

Of course, another key aspect of Thanksgiving is the feast, shared by loved ones as a sign of gratitude for surviving another year and being loved by others. While set in Denmark in the late 19th century, Babette's Feast \(1987, G\) fully captures that Thanksgiving spirit. The film presents the story of two elderly sisters who have tried to keep alive their father's ministry to a remote village in Denmark. Th ey help a French refugee who repays their years of kindness with a sumptuous feast fit for a king. Love is in full force as this small group of believers huddle together against the cold dark and learn that good food truly brings us all together. Part of the Badlands Film Appreciation Society's Foreign Views series \(bfas.art\).

events.description:

Known for his comedies or dramedies about oddballs, director Wes Anderson took his first foray into animation with the stop-motion film Fantastic Mr. Fox \(2009, PG\). Inspired by a story by British children's author Roald Dahl, the film features the titular character tryin g to support his family, only to fall back on his old thieving ways. When he goes after the farms of Boggis, Bunce, and Bean, his old ways t hreaten the entire animal community. They all then must pull together to stop the farmers bent on beating them out of their land. Part of the Badlands Film Appreciation Society's Family Fare series \(bfas.art\).

Early Registration on or before Nov. 18 | $25/adult \(19\+\) or $15 \(youth 6-18\)

5 & under are free.

events.title: Double Dinks: Dink, Laugh, Repeat
events.description:
Get ready for Double Dinks: Dink, Laugh, Repeat, a fun, social, and inclusive pickleball mini tournament designed for players of all skill levels! This doubles event features fixed partners, with teams consisting of any combination of pairings. Teams will be placed into divisions based on their combined player rating, ensuring balanced and competitive matchups. The tournament will follow a pool play \(round robin\) format, where each team faces every other team in their division once.

Players are encouraged to bring energy and creativity to the court. Prizes will be awarded for Top Team, Bottom Team, and Best Dressed Team.

AGES: 8\+

FEE: $10

events.title: 11th European Heart Congress
events.description:
The 11th European Heart Congress, taking place on August 09–10, 2027, in London, UK, is a premier international platform dedicated to advancing heart health, cardiac research, innovative therapies, advanced diagnostics, interventional procedures, and patient-centered cardiac care. The congress will bring together cardiologists, heart specialists, interventional specialists, cardiac surgeons, electrophysiologists, heart researchers, physicians, healthcare professionals, academicians, pharmaceutical and biotechnology experts, medical device specialists, and healthcare technology innovators to exchange knowledge, research, clinical experiences, and emerging developments in heart medicine and cardiac care.

Under the theme “Heart Health in a New Era: Innovation, Precision Medicine & Advanced Cardiac Care,” the congress will explore the rapidly evolving landscape of heart health and cardiac medicine, focusing on precision medicine, advanced heart diagnostics, innovative treatments, minimally invasive procedures, digital heart health, artificial intelligence, heart disease prevention, and personalized approaches to cardiac care. The scientific program will address major areas including coronary artery disease, heart attacks, acute coronary syndromes, heart failure, hypertension, cardiomyopathies, heart valve disease, arrhythmias, electrophysiology, structural heart disease, cardiac imaging, preventive heart care, congenital heart disease, and emerging cardiac therapies.
